key_management_model: HSM-backed, PKCS #11 integration, patented state management for stateful signatures
fips_validated: No (u.trust GP HSM Se-Series FIPS 140-3 certification mentioned in separate press release dated May 12, 2026, but not explicitly linked to Quantum Protect package in this text)
primary_platforms: Utimaco u.trust General Purpose HSM Se-Series
pqc_roadmap_details: Further PQC algorithms (such as SLH-DSA) are on the roadmap for future releases.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA, LMS, XMSS, HSS, XMSS-MT, SLH-DSA (planned)
testing_&_validation_methods: Free, fully functional simulator available for testing algorithms in environment before buying.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Can be activated in-field; hardware exchange is not necessary. Simulator APIs/configuration identical to hardware for easy transfer to production.
